# IMPLY_ISA

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
An instruction set architecture specifically designed for IMPLY (material implication) logic operations on memristive crossbar arrays, enabling in-array computation. Provides a standardized programming model for memristive processing-in-array, bridging the gap between hardware crossbar topology and software control.
